$comment: Human-maintained source of truth for the generated HANDOVER.md. Edit this file, run `npm run handover`, never edit HANDOVER.md by hand.

project.name: WACRM Website CMS
project.tagline: Desktop-first SaaS Website CMS, built module by module as a front-end prototype over a simulated backend.
project.stack: React 19 + TypeScript (strict) + Vite 7 + vite-plugin-singlefile; plain CSS design system; no runtime dependencies beyond React; nothing fetched from a CDN, so the artifact works offline from file://.
project.audience: A new engineer or an AI coding agent (Claude Code, Codex) picking this up cold.

rules: One module at a time: the screen, every CTA/dropdown action, and every operation state — nothing ships half-wired.
Every state must be reachable and code-backed: loading, empty, error, viewer/read-only, conflict, permission denied.
The artifact must open by double-click: single HTML file, no build, no server, no node_modules, no network.
Match the approved mock: typography, spacing, alignment, full-screen fit, no empty gaps.
Never present generated copy as verified fact; no invented claims, no fake analytics.
Dropdown panels must never span the screen. Non-goals: raw HTML/CSS/JS, repeaters, page-level SEO, marketplace, staging, co-editing.
Commit and tag every milestone; keep rollback tags; never persist the GitHub token; rebuild the zip on every change.
Every build ships a zip: `npm run build` ends with `scripts/package.mjs`, which rewrites /home/user/wacrm-app.zip and verifies the WACRM-CMS.html inside it matches the fresh build.
Pushing to GitHub needs a credential that this sandbox does not have — run /home/user/push-to-github.sh with GITHUB_TOKEN, or hand over wacrm-app.bundle. See PUSH-TO-GIT.md.

The reference mocks live in Git at `uploads/` and nowhere else: 16 WebP files (2.9 MB, re-encoded from 27.1 MB of PNG at q86), committed and marked `skip-worktree`, so no working copy exists on disk. Read one with `git -C repo show HEAD:uploads/<file> > /tmp/<file>`.

END-OF-TASK ROUTINE (user's standing instruction): every time a file is created, anything is modified, or a task completes — run `/home/user/checkpoint.sh "what changed"`. It rebuilds the app + HANDOVER + zip, mirrors the tree into repo/, commits, pushes main and all tags, and verifies the remote head. Nothing is left uncommitted.

GitHub credential: /home/user/.gh-token (0600, outside the repo). Expiry date in /home/user/.gh-token-expiry — currently 2026-11-17; checkpoint.sh warns when under 12h remain and prints the regenerate link. Never committed: a pre-commit gate refuses token patterns. If it lapses, the push fails with 401 and nothing is lost — commits stay local until the next checkpoint.
Catalogue counts are computed from the registry (20 types · 23 sections · 14 saved). If a number appears twice in the source, one of them is a defect, not a default.
Only Insert into Page may mutate a page from Module 5, and it must pass `expectRevision` so a stale modal gets a 409.

modules.name: Theme Studio completion + Google Fonts library
modules.notes: Closes the four Tier-A gaps from THEME-STUDIO-BENCHMARK.md: (G1) a derived six-step type scale with ratio, leadings, trackings and fluid clamp(), edited in a Type Scale card and obeyed by the preview; (G2) 13 colour roles adding muted/link/border/ring, 14 measured contrast pairs with per-role thresholds and the divider advisory floor; (G3) a 1:1 specimen sheet covering type, palette, buttons in four states, four field states, alerts, pills, card, table, radius and spacing; (G4) a Revisions rail + diff modal whose restore fills the working copy and never saves. Fonts: the 50 most-used Google Fonts families embedded (2.48 MB woff2, variable-first) plus the full 1,746-family index, searchable with category counts and an embedded-only default; locked rows state the reason. Document schema is now version 2 with a stated v1 migration. Embedded set trimmed from 247 to the top 50 on 2026-11-15 (D16); every family outside the 50 is searchable and one Get click from its fetch command.

decisions.decision: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite single-file build; vanilla JS rejected.
In-document canvas for the builder (not an iframe sandbox).
Advanced inspector visible but locked (4 groups).
19 offered block archetypes, 5 inlined generated photos.
Violet #6D4AFF primary, dark sidebar, light #F4F5F7 canvas.
Backend is not built now; every contract is written into BACKEND-PLAN.md instead.
Prototype states are reachable from the beaker menu (Default / Empty / Error / Publish conflict / Viewer).
Deep links are the QA contract: every screen must restore from its hash on a cold load.

decisions.label: AI mode is a composer over the canvas
decisions.detail: Three tasks (build a page / add a section / rewrite copy), one docked panel, one commit per action. Generation plans first, composes registry blocks, never invents a stat, and binds a generated form to a saved form. See AI-BUILDER-SPEC.md.

decisions.label: One AI surface at a time
decisions.detail: While the composer is open the in-canvas AI Copy popover is suppressed (ai: aiPanel ? null : ai); two AI bubbles at once reads as a bug.

decisions.decision: Theme Studio publishes nothing: Save writes a draft revision, and the release flow (Module 4 today, Module 11 when it ships) is the only publish path.
Nine persisted colour roles plus one derived, read-only on-primary label colour chosen for 4.5:1 — the token the spec assumed but never defined.
Spacing = base (4|8) × density (compact/comfortable/spacious); radius and container width come from closed enums, so every export can be re-imported exactly.
Fonts ship inside the artifact as subsetted woff2 (6 families, OFL 1.1); families without an asset stay visible in the catalogue as Requires ingestion and cannot be selected.

"Almost all Google Fonts" = the top 50 families embedded (popularity order, 18 pinned because the product references them) + all 1,746 indexed with real metadata. Every indexed family carries a Get action that hands over the exact `npm run fonts -- --only=\"<family>\"` command and names the production ingest endpoint. Revised from 247 on 2026-11-15: the artifact had to fit the workspace budget.
Brand fonts (Google Sans, Product Sans, Material Symbols…) are excluded from the catalogue entirely — by the metadata flag and an explicit denylist — because they are not licensed for redistribution.
Font faces are registered lazily per family; M6 built one 14 MB stylesheet on mount.
The divider role is measured against an advisory 1.5:1 legibility floor, not SC 1.4.11's 3:1, because decorative rules are exempt; the focus ring is held to 3:1 because it identifies a control.
`link` is its own role, measured from itself. M6 measured link pairs against primary while no link token existed — the editor and the audit disagreed.
Type sizes are derived (base × ratio^n), never stored; fluid clamp() applies to h1–h3 only so body copy never shrinks with the viewport.
Restore never writes: it loads a revision into the working copy, marks it dirty and pushes an undo entry. Save remains the only write path, so CAS and the audit log stay honest.
Token document is version 2; the reader accepts 1 and 2, derives the four new roles and the default scale for a v1 file, and reports every derived field in the import review.
The specimen renders 1:1 at the studio width rather than scaled inside the 1440 px device frame — a specimen scaled to 42% is unreadable and therefore useless.

One repository, no mirror clone: /home/user/wacrm-app is the Git repository, so no artifact is stored twice. A symlink-based shared-copy variant was tried and abandoned — workspace snapshots drop symlinks and leave the tree inconsistent.

traps: Chrome/Chromium will not launch without the apt batch in environment.bootstrap — that is the container, not the app.
A hash-only goto does not reload; deep-link assertions must goto() then reload().
The store rewrites #/<screen> from its own filters after child effects; a screen owning query params must re-assert them on a short timer (builder uses 220 ms).
The builder's global key handler re-registers dialog listeners mid-dispatch — it must stand down while an overlay owns Escape.
QA counts that depend on a library tab are only valid after switching to that tab (#wb-tab-blocks).
Screenshots are WebP only; the workspace is capped at 128 MB and pruned dependency folders do not persist.
The zip must be built with: zip -rq wacrm-app.zip wacrm-app -x 'wacrm-app/node_modules/*' 'wacrm-app/dist/*' 'wacrm-app/.git/*'.
git commit fails with 'Author identity unknown' until a repo-local user.name/user.email is set.
The sandbox drops .git/config between turns, so the origin URL has to be re-added before a push.
The clean CRM copy (commit c07cbb6) has no CMS module and no GrapesJS — do not look for cms routes or a second editor; the React builder here is the only CMS.

Workspace snapshots and copies drop the execute bit on .githooks/pre-commit — after any restore run chmod +x .githooks/pre-commit and git update-index --chmod=+x .githooks/pre-commit, or git silently ignores the hook.

traps.trap: Two AI surfaces open at once
traps.detail: The in-canvas popover is driven by `ai` state and the composer by `aiPanel`; pass `ai: aiPanel ? null : ai` to Canvas or both render over the same selection.

traps.trap: Streamed generation must not touch the document
traps.detail: streamPlan only reports rows; insertAiPanel does the single commit(). Anything that commits mid-stream breaks undo granularity and the 'page is untouched while it runs' assertion.

traps.trap: A generated form block with no formId renders 'No form attached'
traps.detail: Bind BuilderAPI.forms(siteId)[0] at insert time; if there is none, say 'form needs a saved form' in the toast instead of shipping an empty shell.

traps.trap: The cbar is a 3-part flex row
traps.detail: A pill added to .wb-cbar-l overlaps the centred device group (pointer events intercepted, click times out). Put new toolbar actions in .wb-cbar-r with flex:0 0 auto.
Every session starts with no remote, no identity and no core.hooksPath. Commits fail with 'empty ident name'. Set them (or use push-to-github.sh, which does) before the first commit of a turn.

traps.trap: GitHub main is 18 commits behind the workspace
traps.detail: origin/main = d2dd7db (Module 3 spec review). Everything from Module 3's build onward is local only, and the workspace holds no token, so the push is a fast-forward waiting on a credential.

push-to-github.sh passes the token inline to a single `git push` and never writes it to .git/config, a remote URL or a file; PUSH-TO-GIT.md documents the bundle route for anyone who would rather not share one.

traps: Never run `git sparse-checkout init` in repo/ — with this git build (2.47) it writes `/*` + `!/*/` and removes every directory (src, qa, uploads…) from the working tree, then `set` fails with 'specify directories rather than patterns'. Recover with `git sparse-checkout disable`. Nothing is lost (the objects are in .git), but the tree has to be re-materialised.

uploads/ is a single copy, inside repo/ — the 26 MB of mocks are committed at repo/uploads with MANIFEST.sha256. There is deliberately no second copy at /home/user/uploads; read them out of git instead of restoring a duplicate.

uploads/ is skip-worktree — do not be alarmed that the folder is missing: `git ls-files uploads` still lists 19 paths and `git show HEAD:uploads/...` works. To materialise them, `git update-index --no-skip-worktree $(git ls-files uploads)` then `git checkout -- uploads`; re-hide when done.

History rewrites must be range-limited: `git filter-branch --index-filter … -- d2dd7db..main` keeps the branch base (and therefore the fast-forward to origin) intact. A bare `--all` rewrites the root as well, and the push stops being a fast-forward — recover by re-cloning the pre-rewrite bundle, never by forcing.

Push state as of the token handover: origin/main was d2dd7db (Module 3 spec only). Everything from Module 3's build onward — 30 commits — was local until the first successful push; if a session ever finds origin behind again, run checkpoint.sh rather than assuming the work is safe.
Module 4's builder palette already owns the `lb-*` CSS namespace. Module 5 shipped as `m5-*` after a half-rendered grid exposed the collision — never reuse `lb-` for a new screen.
A card grid whose items are flex columns needs `align-items:start`; with the default `stretch`, Chrome resolves the cyclic height and collapses every card to one text line (thumb computed to 1px).
The section category `Forms` is separate from the block group `Form` (singular). Both are real and are asserted separately in qa_builder.py (C3/C3b) and qa_library.py (C5).

Playwright needs `LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/libs/root/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu` after scripts/qa-env.sh — /tmp is wiped between sessions and the libs must be re-fetched with `apt-get download` (no root available).

firstTenMinutes: Read HANDOVER.md (this file), then MODULE-4-REVIEW.md §J and STATE-COVERAGE.md.
Run npm run qa and confirm the tallies match the table below.
Read handover.config.json — that is where intent, decisions and next steps live.
definitionOfDone: The screen works for every CTA and dropdown, in every state listed in STATE-COVERAGE.md.
tsc --noEmit is clean and the suite for the module is green; no earlier suite regressed.
BACKEND-PLAN.md carries a contract row for every new control.
The commit is tagged module-N-complete, HANDOVER.md is regenerated, and the zip is rebuilt.
